page_title: MCI 6-1 BOU | Manchester City v Bournemouth 04/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+8' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Ionut Radu is alert and denies him.
90+5' 7:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
90+3' Kalvin Phillips (Manchester City) was too forceful with his tackle and Craig Pawson interrupted the game to signal a free kick. That's a free kick to Bournemouth.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
88' 6 - 1 Goal! Nathan Ake (Manchester City) makes the score 6:1 after burying a close-range header in the middle of the goal after a good run and cross by Oscar Bobb.
88' The ball goes out for a corner. Manchester City can continue in their attacking effort.
85' Pep Guardiola prepares a substitution. Bernardo Silva is replaced by Oscar Bobb (Manchester City).
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dominic Solanke departs the field of play to be replaced by Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth).

83' 5 - 1 What a GOAL! A quick turnover allows Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) to mount a one-man counter attack and ends with him scoring with a precise shot from close in that easily beats the keeper. That makes it 5:1.
81' Lloyd Kelly (Bournemouth) leaps highest to meet the resulting set piece and sends his header way off target.
81' Bournemouth earn a corner.

80' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball. The ball is out of play. Bournemouth will have a chance to score from a corner.
79' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) makes a rough challenge and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Manchester City will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
78' Rough tackle by Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Manchester City have a free kick.
76' Referee Craig Pawson points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) goes wild in celebration.
75' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Bournemouth players aren’t happy.

74' 4 - 1 Goal! Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Maximillian Aarons inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball low into the middle of the goal. 4:1.
72' Substitution. Marcus Tavernier makes way for Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth).
71' Andoni Iraola has decided to substitute Philip Billing and he is replaced by Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth).
71' Substitution. Rodri leaves the pitch and is replaced by Kalvin Phillips (Manchester City).
71' Pep Guardiola decides to make a substitution. Julian Alvarez will be replaced by Matheus Nunes (Manchester City).
71' It's time for a substitution. Rico Lewis (Manchester City) comes on in place of John Stones.
69' A pass by Maximillian Aarons (Bournemouth) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
68' Some patient build-up play from Manchester City as they look to unlock the defence.
67' Phil Foden (Manchester City) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Ionut Radu, who smothers the ball.
67' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) works the corner short.

64' 4 - 0 Jeremy Doku produces a sweet pass and picks out Phil Foden (Manchester City) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the middle of the net and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 4:0!
61' OFF THE BAR! Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes off the woodwork. What a strike that was!
59' Phil Foden (Manchester City) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
58' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance! The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
57' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The linesman makes the right call and Manchester City will have a corner.
57' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes the corner with a short pass.
55' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
53' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) sends a cross into the box, but Ionut Radu comes off his line to gather the ball.
52' It looks like Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) saw red with that tackle. Craig Pawson won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Manchester City.
51' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
48' Celebrations are cut short for Bournemouth as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
47' Wait! Referee Craig Pawson immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
47' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
46' Andoni Iraola makes a half-time substitution. Marcos Senesi comes on in place of Chris Mepham (Bournemouth).
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Erling Haaland (Manchester City) comes off for Phil Foden.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
45+3' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Julian Alvarez (Manchester City).

45+3' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Manchester City.
45+1' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes a short corner kick.
44' Andoni Iraola is forced to make a change. Alex Scott (Bournemouth) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Joe Rothwell.
42' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
41' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the left post is denied by a decent save from Ederson.
41' Craig Pawson couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) and blew his whistle. Bournemouth win a free kick.
40' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.

37' 3 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Jeremy Doku lines up a shot and his effort takes a deflection off Manuel Akanji (Manchester City) that wrong foots Ionut Radu and sends it into the back of the net. It's 3:0.

37' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Manchester City win a corner.
37' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
36' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

33' 2 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Jeremy Doku, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Bernardo Silva (Manchester City), who beats Ionut Radu with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
32' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
32' Ilya Zabarnyi (Bournemouth) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Manchester City get a free kick.
31' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.

30' 1 - 0 Goal! Great link up play between Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) and Rodri gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the right side of the goal. 1:0.

28' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
28' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Manchester City.
24' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal.
23' The ball is cleared after Kyle Walker (Manchester City) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
22' Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.
22' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) latches on to a superb cross into the box and hits the left post with a fine header. What a chance!
21' A lofted cross from Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
21' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes it short.
19' A great run by Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender.
18' Rodri (Manchester City) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
15' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

14' Rodri (Manchester City) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Ionut Radu pulls off an easy save.
13' The resulting corner from Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) is cleared.
13' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play and Manchester City manage to earn a corner.

11' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) latched on to a fine cross from the corner kick on the edge of the box. His shot, however, flies narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
10' There's an opportunity for Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
10' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. Manchester City win a corner kick.
8' 79:21 – the ratio of ball possession.

6' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
5' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
2' Manchester City string together a series of short passes.
1' The first half has started.
Manchester City will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Craig Pawson.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
